title: POL-731: policy governing the Pricing Engine
body:
## Scope

The policy below governs use of the Pricing Engine; it is effective. The policy
owner is Mateo Silva (Product Support); yearly audits against the controls
listed here are run by Halvorsen Consulting.

## Requirements

As of the 19 November 2025 review the requirements are:
- Store secrets only in the central vault, never in source control
- Keep production data out of test and development environments
- Tag every cloud resource with an owner and a cost centre

## Status

The policy is effective according to the register. Issued by Luca Moretti on 22
December 2025; 26 exceptions are on file with Product Support and expire at the
yearly audit.
